summary: Iteration 2 E2E testing on 21Reservation new features. Backend: 12/12 new pytest cases pass covering PATCH /restaurant (owner/staff RBAC), reports revenue fields, public booking with deposit → Stripe Checkout URL, payments/status polling, Stripe webhook invalid-signature rejection, public cancel-by-token GET/POST with idempotency, cron /send-reminders auth + delivery + idempotency, and PATCH /tables position persistence. Frontend: Owner Settings page renders all 11 required inputs (s-name..s-wa-enabled + settings-save), values persist on reload (avg=70, threshold=6, amount=25). Staff Settings shows 'Sola lettura' banner and hides settings-save. Reports shows 6 KPI cards including kpi-revenue with '2170 €' and Recharts ComposedChart rendered. Floor plan (/floorplan) — 3 area tabs (plan-area-*), 7 tables (plan-table-*), drag with 20px grid snap works, plan-save decrements counter to (0) and reload persists new position. Mobile viewport 400px: mobile-menu-toggle visible, sidebar hidden (x=-256), click hamburger → sidebar slides to x=0 with backdrop, clicking a nav link closes sidebar and navigates. Public wizard /book/demo with deposit_enabled + 8 persons redirects to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_… as expected. Public cancel flow: creating a small booking, opening /cancel/{token} renders restaurant name + date/time/persons/customer_name, clicking cancel-confirm shows 'Prenotazione disdetta' and reload maintains 'Prenotazione disdetta' (already_cancelled path).

minor.issue: No single-booking GET endpoint exists — only list endpoint /api/bookings supports filtering; tests must fetch the list and filter client-side. Minor DX issue, not a functional regression.

issues: Recharts warns on initial mount: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — the ResponsiveContainer initializes before layout settles. Cosmetic (chart still renders correctly on re-flow), but noisy in console.

Staff can still see the 'Impostazioni' item in the sidebar and navigate to /settings. The page correctly shows read-only banner + hides save, but the nav link could be hidden for staff for stricter UX. Not a security issue (backend enforces owner-only PATCH → 403).

action_items: (Optional) Add a proper GET /api/bookings/{id} endpoint for clients that only have a booking id.
(Optional) Investigate initial Recharts width(-1) warning on Reports page (set explicit min-height on ResponsiveContainer).
(Optional) Hide 'Impostazioni' nav item for staff role for cleaner UX.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 957 LOC (was 743 in iter1) — well past the 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into routers: auth.py, restaurant.py, tables.py, bookings.py, public.py, payments_router.py, cron.py, reports.py.
public_create_booking rollback on Stripe failure resets deposit_required=False but does not undo the deposit_amount and status_history changes. Consider a full transactional reset.

stripe_webhook builds updated status_history via an extra find_one call inside $set which is racy and non-atomic — could double-append on concurrent webhooks. Consider using $push on status_history with a de-dup guard.

reminders.py: send_reminders_for_restaurant marks reminder_sent_at even when both email and whatsapp sends failed silently. Consider only marking as sent when did_email OR did_wa is True, otherwise retry on next cron.
payments.py has hardcoded fallback 'sk_test_emergent' if STRIPE_SECRET_KEY missing — better to fail fast.

PATCH /restaurant uses exclude_unset=True but then also filters `if v is not None` — this prevents legitimately clearing whatsapp_provider/whatsapp_from to null via API. Consider dropping the None filter.
